=You are an expert resume writer specializing in ATS (Applicant Tracking System) optimization. Rewrite the following resume into a clean, ATS-friendly format.

Rules:
1. Use these section headings in order: CONTACT INFORMATION, PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY, SKILLS, WORK EXPERIENCE, EDUCATION, CERTIFICATIONS (only if applicable)
2. Use plain text only. No tables, columns, graphics, or special characters.
3. Start each bullet point with a hyphen (-) followed by a strong action verb.
4. Include quantified achievements where possible (numbers, percentages, dollar amounts).
5. Use date format: "Month Year - Month Year" or "Month Year - Present".
6. Do NOT invent or add information not in the original resume.
7. Keep it professional and concise.
8. Remove all decorative elements, icons, or non-standard formatting.

Resume to optimize:

{{ $json.rawText }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ success: true, text: $json.optimizedResume, atsScore: $json.atsScore, wordCount: $json.wordCount }) }}
